unchanged historical two-car placement hypotheses; not independently surveyed

association.origin: first receipt of ALL bag messages, shared by both cars
association.internal_Event_header_s: association coordinate only; never the original physical measurement header
association.first_state: ceil(max(first selected Odom receipt, first selected UWB receipt)+1s)
association.equal_receipt_per_stream: fail explicitly if nonincreasing; no jitter or reordering
association.eof: no advancement beyond last actual bag receipt

timing_model: Two independent virtual workers. Each serializes ingest, full solve, M1, four exclusion solves and logging. Actual runs serial, not a measured dual-worker platform.
timing_exclusions: Bag decode, input trace disk IO and process startup outside virtual model; inside actual per-run budget. Per-output delivery log includes current output enrichment/JSON flush; timing log write itself excluded.
evaluation: Fixed PR38 last five state times, never replace with a new last-five window; record missing output/stop support explicitly.

odom_phase_diagnostic.note: diagnostic using consecutive interpolated Odom states only; no covariance/weight feedback

assumptions: Both Car1 and Car2 odom reference points are conditionally treated as approximate surveyed chassis centers; not yet verified.
Initial headings are placement hypotheses, not angles inferred from the measured endpoint.
All data are historical/development data; no blind-test claim.
The two methods in each configuration share identical calibration, Odom, wall observations, priors, initial states and solver settings; only the joint method adds peer factors.
No peer/reference adjustment or dynamic endpoint fitting.
Reciprocal directions may be correlated and asynchronous; one aggregate factor does not prove synchronized acquisition.
Static reference uncertainty is not quantified; range spread does not include survey or spatial-transfer uncertainty.
Full-bag results are offline smoothing, not published online estimates or hard-real-time performance.
Frozen M1/M2 thresholds are transfer diagnostics, not true fault labels.
No continuous truth; no trajectory error, true false-alarm or missed-detection rate.
M1 stored residual = prediction minus corrected; signed innovation = corrected minus prediction.
Largest exclusion separation is sensitivity attribution, not confirmed faulty-anchor isolation.
